title: Easy-to-give gifts for others … and yourself

body:
Give virtual (live or on-demand) access to the Southern Lights Conference.

Join Diana Butler Bass and me as we host the Southern Lights Conference on January 23-25, 2026 on beautiful St. Simons Island. (Because 2026 will be a sabbatical year for me, this is one of only two times I will be speaking publicly this coming year.)

Diana and I will start the gathering with presentations on how we've been coping with fear, grief, confusion, and loss in the last year. Our reflections open to the larger theme: Wisdom From the Edge, When the Center Cannot Hold.

Our special guests include Dr. Jemar Tisby, Rev. Dr. Jennifer Harvey, Rabbi Or Rose, musical genius Ken Medema, and poet Rosemerry Wahtola Trommer. With preaching, teaching, poetry, and music, Southern Lights is a real gift.

For more information, you'll be taken to the [Southern Lights website](https://southernlightsconference.com/) where you can view speaker bios, read about the venue, and explore the FAQs. There are virtual and in-person registration options.

Give one of my books – paper, digital, or audio.

You'll find a complete list on the [books page](/books), and ebooks on the [store](https://payhip.com/BrianMcLaren).

Of special interest: [The Last Voyage](/archive/the-last-voyage-my-new-sci-fi-novel) – first in a fictional trilogy (books 2 and 3 coming in 2026 and 2027), and Cory and the Seventh Story – a children's book.
